name: R5-T3
description: R5-T3, also known as "Sparks" was an R5 astromech droid used by Dex Tiree. It was named after a saying Dex's mother said often, "Small sparks light big fires." Sparks and Dex perished in the Battle of Yavin.

data.name: R5-T3
data.death: During the Battle of Yavin, Yavin system
